# Machine-specific sensitive terms -- TEMPLATE (published; copy it, do not edit it).
#
# Setup on a new machine:
#   Copy-Item tools\sensitive-terms.example.txt .local\sensitive-terms.txt
#   then replace the made-up entries below with YOUR OWN literals.
#
# .local/ is gitignored, so the filled-in file never leaves your machine.
# This template stays in tools/ so that a fresh clone is self-documenting.
#
# publish.ps1 refuses to push if any of these strings appears in a publishable file.
# One term per line. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# Keep every term as LONG as you can stand. Very short terms (a 3-4 letter given
# name, a common word) produce false positives that block your publishes.
# Prefer the full account handle, the full LAN address, the numeric account id.
#
# Example entries (all made up -- replace them):
#
#   my-github-handle
#   192.0.2.77
#   my-hostname
#   12345678
#   MyProjectCodename
